text.en:
Barangays Calula, Casacon, Gango, Katipunan, Kulambugan, Mabini, Magsaysay, New
Antique, New Sagay, Siawang, Silingan, Surabay, Tilasan, and Tupilac are separated from the Municipality of
Ipil, Province of Zamboanga del Sur, and constituted into an independent and distinct municipality of the
province which shall be known as the Municipality of Roseller Lim, with the seat of government in the
present site of Barangay Surabay.

The boundaries of the New Municipality of Roseller Lim shall be:
"Beginning from point marked ‘1’ at the center of the mouth of Gango creek; thence following the shore line
southwesterly to Busan Bay to point ‘2’ at the mouth of Tupilac River; thence following Tupilac River going
upstream until it reaches the provincial boundary of Zamboanga del Sur and Zamboanga del Norte known as
point ‘3’; thence following the provincial boundary of Zamboanga del Sur and Zamboanga del Norte with an
approximate distance of 21,000 meters to point ‘4’; thence S 81 degrees 00 minutes E with a distance of
2,350 meters to point ‘5’; thence N 15 degrees 00 minutes E with a distance of 6,500 meters to point ‘6’ at
the bank of Gango creek; thence south-westerly following Gango creek downstream with a distance of 1,200
meters to point ‘7’; thence south easterly following Gango creek downstream with approximate distance of
9,800 meters to point ‘1’ which is the point of beginning."
